notes: A DATE YOU TYPED IS ACCEPTED OR REFUSED — NEVER QUIETLY MOVED. If you changed the date on a saved draft to a day that falls outside every open accounting period, the draft saved without complaint. You only found out when you tried to post it, and got "Entry date … is outside period FY…" — after filling in the whole voucher. Nothing was ever recorded wrongly; the check was always there, it simply came at the wrong moment. It now happens when you save, and says what to do: open that period, or choose a date inside one that is open. WHY IT HAPPENED. The routine that decides which period an entry belongs to serves two callers with opposite needs. A REVERSAL is handed a date the system chose and has to land somewhere sensible, so when no period accepts that date the routine returns the nearest period with the date moved into it. A person typing a date is the other case entirely — moving it silently would be worse than refusing, because you would never learn the entry is not where you put it. The draft-editing code was reading the period from that routine and discarding the moved date, so the draft ended up carrying your date with a period that does not contain it. The two are now compared. WHAT STILL WORKS THE SAME. Re-dating a draft into a DIFFERENT open period — the ordinary case — moves the draft to that period and posts normally, exactly as before. There are no data changes in this release. Back up before installing, as always, then install over the top.
